artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Extends HVST-h-4/h-5's module without editing their functions' behaviour (AC0/AC2 both equal to baseline). New: GOLD_EVENT_TABLE='chatter_event', EVENT_MIN_ARTICLES=2/EVENT_MIN_PUBLISHERS=2/EVENT_MAX_GAP_DAYS=1 (working defaults), GOLD_EVENT_SCHEMA; event_rows(mention_rows, min_articles, min_publishers, max_gap_days) -- PURE, groups tier A/B rows per security per UTC day (_day_of), marks a day QUALIFYING at >=min_articles rows from >=min_publishers distinct publishers (_publisher_of), merges consecutive qualifying days whose non-qualifying gap is <= max_gap_days, and for each merged [first_day,last_day] span collects every tier A/B row in ANY day of the span (qualifying or not) as the event's article_keys, sorted by (tier rank, published_utc, article_key) -- the same key that picks the deterministic lead (highest tier, earliest published_utc, lowest article_key); event_id = sha256(security_key|first_day|last_day); _headline_by_article_key(client) reads every source's latest silver article rows (via the existing _iter_latest_articles) to build {article_key: title}, because the article_security_mention gold table never stores headline text; build_event(securities, as_of_date, client) reads the newest mention snapshot, enriches each row with its title, calls event_rows, writes ONE chatter_event gold snapshot via write_gold(schema=GOLD_EVENT_SCHEMA), and returns the CLI summary with events_per_security naming every security (0 allowed). New CLI subcommand build-event --securities-json FILE --as-of YYYY-MM-DD.

New file, exactly the eight arms section 1 item 3 names: test_single_publisher_burst_is_not_an_event, test_two_publishers_two_articles_is_an_event, test_gap_of_one_day_merges, test_gap_of_two_days_splits, test_tier_c_and_d_do_not_qualify, test_lead_headline_is_deterministic, test_event_lists_its_articles, test_rebuild_identical. Pure fixtures throughout; no network, no live bucket.
